description: This file defines a React functional component named IconPicker. It provides a user interface for selecting icons or emojis, with different modes and platform-specific instructions. The component manages internal state for current selection and rendering logic, utilizing other imported components and utility functions.

classes.name: IconPicker
classes.description: React functional component for selecting icons or emojis. Manages internal state, renders tabs and input controls, communicates selected icon/emojis through callback props.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Switches between 'icon' and 'emoji' modes or resets the selection.

methods.name: handleIconChange
methods.description: Invokes callback with the selected icon or emoji value.

methods.name: handleEmojiChange
methods.description: Updates emoji input value, checks emoji length, and updates selection accordingly.
